evaluation.gt: s1051 scoring only after predictions; no fitting; actual camera pitch evaluation only

method: Consecutive own-RGB floor LK/RANSAC SE2; differential velocity EKF, Joseph covariance (robot_localization). Buffered completed pulse replaces command response once, then all original wall frames are replayed in order. Unknown intervals retain fixed command model, never zero observations.
tracking: Previous registered LK/RANSAC parameters unchanged; replace 2D point spread gate with full rank SE2 least-squares Jacobian. New code only. Coarse loaded translations with fixed commanded arm posture only, including existing 0.65 lateral pulses; smaller commands retain baseline prediction.
covariance: Pixel/fit covariance plus finite-difference camera pitch nuisance Jacobian. Common pitch uncertainty summed coherently across pulse, not divided by frame count. Independent before/after pitch uncertainty conservatively correlated across pulse. Full measurement covariance for EKF, marginal diagonal for existing PF ABI. No zero-motion update for missing texture.
recovery: Observed odometry only; two same-direction fully-covered pulses with 2sigma upper displacement below 3.5 cm and >=1.5 s without progress inhibit failed direction. Stop, bounded inverse-direction fine pulses checked against own static-map estimate, then clear path and replan with inferred failed target keepout. No GT wall/contact. Unknown recovery progress cannot release inhibition.
recovery_replay_limit: Fixed recorded actions cannot prove counterfactual escape. Estimator replay uses originals; separate shadow policy audits suppression/replan. Actual emitted recovery actions tested with synthetic own observations; physical escape only in gated fresh DEV.
full_rule: Every criterion must pass. Otherwise no new seed/bundle/physics. Exploration only; never combine prior outcomes.
